name: api_incidents_client_decision
_description: PLAN V1.0 Bloque 9 - POST /api/v1/incidents/client-decision (PUBLIC, sin JWT). Cliente aprueba/rechaza la opcion seleccionada usando incident_id (UUID v4 = token). UPDATE status=approved|rejected + INSERT client_decisions (anti scope-creep) + Gmail al architect.
_status: B9 (PLAN V1.0 ejecucion). Endpoint publico tipo proposals/public.

parameters.query:
-- super_admin bypassa RLS - este endpoint es publico
WITH ctx AS (SELECT set_config('app.role', 'super_admin', false) AS r)
SELECT i.id, i.project_id, i.tenant_id, i.description, i.location, i.severity,
       i.options, i.selected_option_index, i.cost_delta_eur, i.time_delta_days,
       i.status, i.client_communication_draft,
       p.name AS project_name, c.name AS client_name, c.email AS client_email
FROM project_incidents i
JOIN projects p ON p.id = i.project_id
JOIN clients c ON c.id = p.client_id, ctx
WHERE i.id = $1::uuid
LIMIT 1;

WITH upd AS (
  UPDATE project_incidents
     SET status = $2
   WHERE id = $1::uuid AND status = 'communicated'
  RETURNING id, status
),
dec AS (
  INSERT INTO client_decisions (
    project_id, tenant_id, decision_tipo, decision_descripcion,
    contexto_propuesta, impacto_economico, impacto_plazo_dias,
    confirmada_cliente, metodo_confirmacion, evidencia_url, fecha_decision
  )
  SELECT $3::uuid, $4::uuid, 'otro',
         'Imprevisto en obra: ' || $5 || ' (decision cliente: ' || $2 || ')',
         $6::jsonb, $7::numeric, $8::int,
         true, 'email', NULL, now()
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM upd)
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT (SELECT id FROM upd) AS incident_updated_id,
       (SELECT id FROM dec) AS decision_id;
